bar_1500_close_is_bar_extreme.reading: in the 8 sessions without a 15:15 bar the 15:00 bar closes AT the official close and (5 of 8) that close is also the bar high: the closing print is attached to the 15:00 bar

windows.unit_note: volume shares are shares of the SUM OF BAR VOLUME of the session (87-100% of NSE daily volume); a session without a 15:15 bar contributes 0 to that slot (print folded into the 15:00 bar).

profile.effective_sample: sessions (n=37); bars within a session are dependent. Slot 15:15 n=29.

benchmark_probabilities_mc.note: driftless martingale on the empirical variance clock; arcsine law with a uniform clock would give 0.262 for any 16% window

missed_tick_sensitivity.rule: bars whose high (low) is within max(official shortfall, 1 tick) of the bar maximum (minimum) are treated as possible holders of the extreme

timing.range_note: ranges are bar highs/lows (the bars miss up to Rs 5 of the official extremes in some sessions); MC range uses 1-minute steps (slight downward bias of the simulated range).

v1_invalidation_trigger_first_hour_gt_1..rule: |FH| >= 1.5% and first-hour bar volume > 2x the median first-hour volume of the union sessions

close_vs_vwap.note: closing price is the closing-auction price; exchange VWAP = turnover/volume (bhavcopy)

levels.touch_note: benchmark = zero-drift reflection principle from the official open with sigma_i = RMS of the previous 20 daily open-to-close log returns; it ignores jumps, fat tails and the overnight gap beyond the open.

R01.label: previous-day HIGH: P(close above | touched from below)

R02.label: previous-day LOW: P(close below | touched from above)

levels.follow_up_note: pre-2026-08-03 closes are 30-minute VWAP, not the closing-auction price, so open-to-close in the long history is not the same quantity as in the union window

zero_volume_vs_positive_volume_1515_bar.note: volume in this bar is feed volume, not the auction volume (auction volume is not identifiable in this dataset)

sensitivity_including_failed_sessions_15.note: 10-Sep fails the validator ONLY on the bar-continuity rule: its 15:15 bar opens at the auction price (3306.0 vs 15:00 close 3286.1 = +0.60%), i.e. a large genuine auction jump is excluded by that rule

session_2026-09-29.note: 15:15 bar absent; the 15:00 bar close 3200.0 equals the official close and the 15:00 bar volume (22.5M) is 75% of NSE daily volume

anatomy.spike_rule_fixed_in_advance: volume >= 5x slot median of other sessions and bar range >= 2%

defects_in_v1_definitions: volume_share_last_bar_1515_pct = volume of the LAST ROW / total: that row is the 15:15 bar in 28 sessions but the 15:00 bar in 8 sessions (feed omits 15:15), so the 4.4% mixes two different bars; the pure 15:15 bar share is 0.87% (v1's own time-profile csv) and the 15:00 bar is ~9%
volume_share_last_hour_pct uses the last four ROWS: 14:30-15:15 in 28 sessions but 14:15-15:00 in 8 sessions (misaligned)

last_bar_1515_abs_move = |ln(close[-1]/close[-2])|: for 15:15-bar sessions it is |ln(official close/15:00 close)| (includes the jump between the 15:00 close and the 15:15 bar open), for 24-bar sessions it is the 15:00 bar's own close-to-close move; neither is the within-bar auction move
first-hour return starts at the first printed bar open (not the official open); the 'rest' leg is unaffected
P(close above bar-VWAP) uses typical-price bar VWAP, which differs from the exchange VWAP (turnover/volume) by 6 bps on average and by -36 bps on 29-Sep

power.touch_test_note: each touch test is a sum of 37 Bernoulli outcomes with benchmark probabilities spread over 0.05-1.0; a 10-point shift in the touch rate is not detectable
power.bootstrap_independence: iid session bootstrap and circular block (3) bootstrap; sessions are consecutive trading days Aug-18..Oct-13 (one regime: closing-auction era, 3-Aug onward).

effective_sample.note: 37 non-overlapping sessions; every bar-level statistic has the 37 (29 for the 15:15 bar) sessions as its effective sample; 36 of the 37 sessions are the sessions of v1 (v1: 36) so union results are not independent of v1.

tests.label: mean share of range formed by 10:15
mean share of range formed by 11:15
previous-day HIGH: P(close above | touched from below)
previous-day LOW: P(close below | touched from above)

test_registry.note: all p-values two-sided; Holm (FWER) and Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) are applied across the whole registered family
